decisions.reason: Launched only in 2023 and close to the firm's established dumper range, its prospects are still unresolved and keeping it costs little given shared engineering, parts and service infrastructure.
This articulated dumper extends the core construction offer, so it is a cheap option to hold while first-year market results are too sparse to justify abandoning it.

The mine rescue vehicle is distant from the core offer and carries higher uncertainty and holding cost, but one year of niche, long-cycle demand reveals too little to abandon it, and it builds on the firm's underground expertise.
A multi-model telescopic loader line close to the established business keeps several growth options open, and there is no evidence yet that its value will not be realized.
